text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After an outing with Agnes Tachyon, we decide to go for some tea. On our way back to the academy…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You know… Trainer, I've been thinking this for a while…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You look quite tired. Are you taking good care of yourself?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Goodness, what a vague reply.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'm going to head to the laboratory, but you'd better go get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Like I always say, things are evolving and changing every day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What one considers correct today might turn out the exact opposite tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If you're not careful, you may find yourself affixed to obsolete knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Understand?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In other words, body modification is not about obtaining makeshift power, but the pursuit of potential…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, remember that one student who came to me asking for some miracle potion of speed?

text_block_list.name: Curly-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Please! Can I have some?! I… want to become faster!

text_block_list.name: Curly-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'm always losing… so I don't care if I cheat anymore!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It makes me wonder… Do you understand the significance of the research I am doing… the reason behind my experimentation?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's researching how to overcome the limits of Umamusume-kind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a pursuit of boundless possibilities—a journey to realize untapped potential.
choice_data_list: Is it proof of your conviction?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! Good answer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: My research! My experiments! These are just a fraction of the potential paths to my goal!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'm glad that my guinea pig has been able to grasp this. Keep up your good work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, my body begins to sway unsteadily.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what happened? Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon's voice is distant. My whole body loses its strength… and I collapse on the spot.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah, you've come back.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In the dorm lobby. Don't worry, I got permission to bring you in here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Agnes Tachyon carried me here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm able to move again, but a sudden wave of fatigue hits me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Just as I thought… I should have urged you to go home as soon as I noticed you weren't feeling well.
choice_data_list: I was just a little tired.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, you are a highly valuable test subject, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'd be in some trouble if you were no longer fit for the purpose.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I want you to take your role seriously and start paying closer attention to your health.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her words are the same as always, but this time, I feel that her words are coming from a place of appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Really? You know, you still look pale.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems so worried, I wonder if a joke will cheer her up.
choice_data_list: In that case, you got anything that'd cure me?
In that case, you got anything that'd cure me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Mhm… I see. Very, very interesting. I like what I'm hearing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Wonderful! That's a delightful change of heart! I do love a cooperative guinea pig!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Just leave it to me! Whether it's nourishment or a blast of energy, I can promise you the results you desire!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If the effects seem a bit extra, just consider it a bonus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems I cheered her up a bit too much.
